title: Storyboard to one continuous shot
pitch: Three frames of one place, then one unbroken shot that travels through them.
why: Same seed and the same words keep the layout of each board close, so first and last frame control can walk through time without a cut. Each clip starts on the frame the last one ended on, so the join is a hard cut you cannot see.

fields.label: The place
fields.default: a stone cottage beside a huge old oak tree on a green hill, seen from far away, photographed from one fixed spot

models.name: MiniMax H3
models.note: Show the name in commercial products. Read the licence's territory terms before you rely on it.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Keep the words for the place identical in each board; change only the season or the time.
Keep the camera locked: the change is the show.

steps.label: Winter to spring
steps.model: MiniMax H3 first and last frame

steps.label: Spring to autumn
steps.model: MiniMax H3 first and last frame

expected.basis: sum of each step's measured time on this box, with a cold start per step

raw_steps.label: Board 1: winter
raw_steps.prompt: Wide landscape photograph of {place}, deep winter, thick snow on the ground and on the bare branches, pale cold light. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: Board 2: spring
raw_steps.prompt: Wide landscape photograph of {place}, high spring, fresh green leaves and white blossom on the branches, soft morning light. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: Board 3: autumn
raw_steps.prompt: Wide landscape photograph of {place}, late autumn, burning gold and red leaves, low golden evening light. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: Winter to spring
raw_steps.prompt: Time passes in one shot: the snow melts away, the grass rises, leaves and blossom open along the branches. Wind and birdsong grow

raw_steps.label: Spring to autumn
raw_steps.prompt: Time passes in one shot: the green leaves turn gold and red, the light drops low and warm, the first leaves fall. Wind in the branches
